caption: The drawing features three stylized floral motifs arranged on a plain, off-white background. The motif in the upper left consists of a branch with a dark blue flower with a white center and scalloped edges, accompanied by multiple elongated, teardrop-shaped leaves in yellow, dark blue, light tan, and red. The motif in the lower right is similar, featuring a brown flower with a circular tan center and scalloped edges, with a branch bearing leaves in dark blue, tan, yellow, and red. The top right motif displays a curved yellow stem with rounded bumps, ending in a pink, red, and brown grouping of similar elongated leaves, and supporting a blue flower with a white center and outer edge outlined in red. All branches are thin and curving, rendered in either brown or blue. The color palette consists mainly of blue, yellow, brown, red, tan, and pink, and the shapes are composed of clean, flat areas of color with no shading. The motifs are spaced apart and do not overlap. There is a handwritten note in brown ink in the lower right corner.
title: Design from Proposed Portfolio
